mcqs.question: Which provision of the Lok Sabha Rules was cited to declare questions on PM CARES, PMNRF and the National Defence Fund inadmissible?
options: Rule 41(2)(viii) covers matters not primarily concerning the Government of India, while Rule 41(2)(xvii) covers bodies not primarily accountable to the Government of India
Rule 41(2)(viii) covers bodies not primarily accountable to the Government of India, while Rule 41(2)(xvii) covers matters not primarily concerning the Government of India
Both Rule 41(2)(viii) and Rule 41(2)(xvii) cover matters not primarily concerning the Government of India
Both Rule 41(2)(viii) and Rule 41(2)(xvii) cover bodies not primarily accountable to the Government of India
mcqs.explanation: Rule 41(2)(viii) concerns matters not primarily concerning the Government of India, while Rule 41(2)(xvii) concerns bodies not primarily accountable to the Government of India. The tempting reversed pairing is incorrect because it assigns each clause the subject of the other clause.
